title: When 'I' became 'we'
text: A friend announced 'we are finally going to write a novel'; the co-author was not his wife but AI. The writer, who earns a living writing ads, refuses AI: once 'a storyteller in everyone' meant imagination, now it may mean the power of AI.
use: For 'The process of self-discovery has now been technologically outsourced' (2021) and 'Inspiration for creativity springs from the effort to look for the magical in the mundane' (2023).

title: Technology denial that built a nation
text: Faced with restrictions on access to advanced technology, India's atomic energy programme built its own capabilities; scientific leadership, freedom for scientists, trust in young people and acceptance of failure made it possible.
use: For 'The Empires of the future will be the empires of the mind' (2024) and 'Best lessons are learnt through bitter experiences' (2025).

title: A simple idea with large consequences
text: Tamil Nadu employs 40.3% of India's directly employed women factory workers, helped by dormitories near factories that solve women's two main barriers: distance and a safe place to live.
use: For 'All ideas having large consequences are always simple' (2024) and 'Patriarchy is the least noticed yet the most significant structure of social inequality' (2020).
